# Crates derived from rust-analyzer

blaze's front end: parsing, name resolution, type inference, MIR and the borrow checker. These
crates started as a fork of [rust-analyzer](https://github.com/rust-lang/rust-analyzer) and are
now members of blaze's own workspace (the root `Cargo.toml`, one `Cargo.lock`); they are no
longer synced with upstream. rust-analyzer is MIT OR Apache-2.0 (`LICENSE-MIT`,
`LICENSE-APACHE`), as are these crates.
